FOOD VENDOR BUSINESS DETAILS
Business Name

Tasty Bites Kitchen & Catering Services

Business Type

Food Vendor / Catering & Food Delivery Services

Business Description

Tasty Bites Kitchen & Catering Services is a food business dedicated to preparing and serving fresh, delicious, hygienic, and affordable meals for individuals, families, offices, schools, events, and other occasions.

We provide both ready-to-eat meals and catering services, with a focus on quality ingredients, excellent customer service, cleanliness, and timely delivery.
